messages:
claire-docs: Pushing a small docs PR to add migration notes for v1->v2 audit API and examples for retention config + SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534
ben-legal: Thanks. Make sure SOC2 language is advisory. Use "recommended" and link to #compliance. Avoid absolutes.
rina-security: Security nit: show how to rotate keys and include example for pseudonymization before export. Don't encourage embedding keys in values.yaml.
claire-docs: Current draft snippet (working):

```
# values.yaml (illustrative)
audIt:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 365 # example, recommended only
  storage:
    provider: s3
    bucket: redwood-audit
    kms_key_ref: "{{ .Values.kms.key_ref }}"
```

theo-devex: Can you add a short Python SDK v2 migration example? Folks script provisioning.

```python
# python SDK v2
client.update_audit_config(retention_days=365, kms_key=os.getenv('KMS_REF'))
```

ben-legal: LGTM after you add compliance pointer and remove any "must".
rina-security: Also add one-line: "# Avoid storing raw PII; pseudonymize/redact before export; prefer CMKs or SAS tokens."
claire-docs: Updated PR with all asks, removed hardcoded keys, added rotation note and SDK snippet. Tagging @ben-legal @rina-security for final pass.
docs-bot: docs PR 534 checks: linkcheck passed, build ok :white_check_mark:
ben-legal: Approved wording. rina-security: security ok.
claire-docs: Merged to main. Deploy to staging queued. Thanks!
